commands.name: remote-records
commands.title: Remote Records
commands.subtitle: Read Context Server Records
commands.description: Read records from a local or Cloudflare Context Server.

commands.name: context-settings
commands.title: Context Settings
commands.subtitle: View Server Connection Settings
commands.description: View and verify the local or Cloudflare Context Server connection.

commands.name: start-voice-capture
commands.title: Start Voice Capture
commands.subtitle: Start Local Rolling Buffer
commands.description: Start the local microphone rolling buffer.

commands.name: stop-voice-capture
commands.title: Stop Voice Capture
commands.subtitle: Stop Microphone, Keep Buffer
commands.description: Stop microphone input while retaining the local buffer.

commands.name: capture-recent-voice
commands.title: Capture Recent Voice
commands.subtitle: Create Context Draft
commands.description: Transcribe the recent local voice buffer and review a Context Draft.

commands.name: clear-voice-buffer
commands.title: Clear Voice Buffer
commands.subtitle: Delete Local Audio
commands.description: Immediately delete local audio and pending transcription.

preferences.name: serverUrl
preferences.title: Context Server URL
preferences.description: The local or Cloudflare Context Server base URL (without /v1/records).

preferences.name: apiToken
preferences.title: Context Server API Token
preferences.description: Use one token with both read and write scopes. It is stored as a secret preference.

preferences.name: brainUrl
preferences.title: Brain Server URL
preferences.description: Defaults to the local server-brain. Only the transcript, never audio, is sent here.

preferences.name: brainApiToken
preferences.title: Brain Server API Token
preferences.description: Optional secret token when server-brain authentication is enabled.

preferences.name: whisperCliPath
preferences.title: Whisper CLI Path
preferences.description: Absolute path to the local whisper.cpp whisper-cli executable.

preferences.name: whisperModelPath
preferences.title: Whisper Model Path
preferences.description: Absolute path to a multilingual whisper.cpp GGML model.

scripts.build: node scripts/build-voice-helper.mjs && ray build --environment dist --output dist
scripts.fix-lint: eslint src test --fix && prettier --write src test package.json .prettierrc
scripts.lint: eslint src test && prettier --check src test package.json .prettierrc
